description: Source code for toolbar tools in the Notesnook editor, defining various text formatting functions such as Italic, Bold, Underline, Strikethrough, Code, Subscript, Superscript, ClearFormatting, CodeRemove, and Math, utilizing a ToolButton component and editor chain commands.

methods.name: Italic
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle italic formatting in the editor.

methods.name: Strikethrough
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle strikethrough formatting.

methods.name: Underline
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle underline formatting.

methods.name: Code
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle inline code formatting.

methods.name: Bold
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle bold formatting.

methods.name: Subscript
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle subscript formatting.

methods.name: Superscript
methods.description: Renders a button to toggle superscript formatting.

methods.name: ClearFormatting
methods.description: Renders a button to clear all formatting.

methods.name: CodeRemove
methods.description: Renders a button to remove code formatting if active and in bottom toolbar.

methods.name: Math
methods.description: Renders a button to insert inline math, disabled if code block is active.
